notes: Covers the M1 13-inch 2020 model (A2338 / EMC 3578). The M2 A2338 variant (mid 2022, EMC 8162) is not covered.

gaps: No logic-board or battery-board parts documented.
method: Apple's M1 13-inch 2020 spec page and iFixit's device page (A2338 / EMC 3578, released November 2020) identify the model; iFixit's battery listing ties A2338 (EMC 3578, Late 2020) to the M1 and also lists a different A2338 variant (M2, mid 2022, EMC 8162), which this record does not cover.

The Apple page gives battery, adapter, display, camera and speaker facts. iFixit's battery guide refers to a fan. iFixit's battery listing names replacement pack A2171 (5100 mAh, 58.2 Wh) and lists A2338 as compatible.

comps.spec: 61W USB-C Power Adapter listed with the laptop
A fan is present; the guide refers to the battery cell that lies nearest the fan (no fan type or part number given)
Stereo speakers with high dynamic range
